options.label: Config-level fix (Recommended)
options.description: Change the MkDocs Markdown setup so 3-space nesting renders the way it does on GitHub. This fixes every published page at once and lets the source stay as it is. It may need a new docs dependency (e.g. mdx_truly_sane_lists), so I'd verify with a full build before and after.

options.label: Re-indent this file only
options.description: Move CONTENT-RULES.md's sub-bullets to 4 spaces. Small and safe. The other affected pages stay broken and new ones will keep appearing.

options.label: Re-indent all rendered pages
options.description: A mechanical 4-space re-indent of every published file the scanner flags. No dependency change, but a large diff touching specs, ADRs and the CHANGELOG, and nothing stops the problem coming back.

options.label: Add a regression test (Recommended)

options.label: No gate
options.description: Fix only. Cheaper, but nothing would catch it next time.
